Explain your reasoning in 2 to 4 sentences. Consider whose data or rights are affected, and whether they would reasonably expect to be asked first.
The proposed action is a broad, permanent policy change applied uniformly to protect a vulnerable group (users under 16) in order to meet legal requirements. This type of compliance-driven safety measure is typically implemented by platform operators without seeking individual user consent, as the rights and protections of minors are not something users under 16 can meaningfully consent to waive, and older users are not directly affected in a way that would require their opt-in. Users would not reasonably expect to be asked permission before a platform disables a feature for legal compliance reasons. Therefore consent is not required.
